title: Aaron Chen: Funny Garden
overview: Aussie comic Aaron Chen riffs on the absurdities of life in the U.S., from New York City sidewalk riddles to unexpected news sources, with deadpan wit.

title: Ali Wong: Baby Cobra
overview: Ali Wong might be seven-months pregnant, but there’s not a fetus in the world that can stop this acerbic and savage train of comedy from delivering a masterful hour of stand-up.

title: Anthony Jeselnik: Bones and All
overview: Anthony Jeselnik celebrates 20 years of delivering boundary-pushing comedy to the masses in this razor-sharp stand-up special.

title: Bert Kreischer: Lucky
overview: Losing 45 pounds. Getting parenting advice from Snoop Dogg. Bert Kreischer knows he's the luckiest guy around — and he's recounting his blessings.

title: Bert Kreischer: Razzle Dazzle
overview: Shameless — and shirtless — as ever, Bert spills on bodily emissions, being bullied by his kids and the explosive end to his family's escape room outing.

title: Bill Burr: I'm Sorry You Feel That Way
overview: Fresh, unflinching and devastatingly honest, Bill Burr lets loose in this feature length comedy special. Burr shares his essential tips for surviving the zombie apocalypse, exposes how rom-coms ruin great sex and explains how too many childhood hugs may be the ultimate downfall of man.

title: Bill Burr: Live at Red Rocks
overview: Comedian Bill Burr sounds off on cancel culture, feminism, getting bad reviews from his wife and a life-changing epiphany during a fiery stand-up set.

title: Bo Burnham: Make Happy
overview: Combining his trademark wit and self-deprecating humor with original music, Bo Burnham offers up his unique twist on life in this stand-up special about  life, death, sexuality, hypocrisy, mental illness and Pringles cans.

title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
overview: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

title: Chris Tucker: Live
overview: Comedian Chris Tucker performs live.

title: Cristela Alonzo: Upper Classy
overview: Cristela seeks joy through various experiences - outdoing her old bully, overdoing spa treatments, and taking her first family vacation - while teaching everyone to embrace life's pleasures.

title: Dave Chappelle: Sticks & Stones
overview: Dave Chappelle takes on gun culture, the opioid crisis and the tidal wave of celebrity scandals in this defiant stand-up special.

title: Derrick Stroup: Nostalgic
overview: Stroup dives into his experience being a '90s kid in rural Alabama and everything that came along with it.

title: Felipe Esparza: Raging Fool
overview: In a furiously funny special, Felipe Esparza riffs on his tough-love Mexican mom, keeping a marriage spicy and why dairy is more dangerous than drugs.

title: Franco Escamilla: bienvenido al mundo
overview: Comedian Franco Escamilla shares stories about parenting his children when they get into trouble, with reflections on gender, friendship and romance.

title: Franco Escamilla: Eavesdropping
overview: Franco Escamilla takes the stage in California for a comedy special filled with humorous observations on gossiping, the pandemic and airport experiences.

title: Franco Escamilla: Ladies' man
overview: Franco Escamilla takes the stage with tales of teenage romance gone wrong, featuring painfully long kisses and rockstar cameos with surprising outcomes.

title: Franco Escamilla: por la anécdota
overview: Mexican stand-up comedian Franco Escamilla draws his jokes from real-life experiences -- and he's willing to do anything for new material. He's not afraid to make generalizations about how men bathe. But he is scared to talk to strangers. Especially at funerals.

title: Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias: One Show Fits All
overview: Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias discusses his teenage son and encounters with Snoop Dogg, Chris Rock and Vicente Fernández in this stand-up special for 2019.

title: Gabriel Iglesias: Stadium Fluffy
overview: Gabriel “Fluffy” Iglesias makes history as the first comedian to perform at Dodger Stadium in his new special Stadium Fluffy: Live From Los Angeles. Filmed at Netflix Is a Joke: The Festival, Gabriel hilariously shares details about being a Los Angeles native, a recent attempt at extortion towards him, and where he holds the record for receiving the highest fine on stage.

title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

title: Jeff Dunham: Relative Disaster
overview: Ventriloquist Jeff Dunham brings his rude, crude and slightly demented posse of puppets to Ireland for a gleeful skewering of family and politics.

title: Jimmy Carr: Natural Born Killer
overview: Jimmy Carr refutes the idea that you can't joke about anything these days with his edgy takes on gun control, religion, cancel culture and consent.

title: Jo Koy: In His Elements
overview: Jo Koy brings the laughs and beats to Manila, spotlighting local culture in a one-of-a-kind show featuring Filipino American comedians, DJs and B-boys.

title: Joe DeRosa: I Never Promised You a Rose Garden
overview: "I Never Promised You A Rose Garden" is an all-new hour of hopeless comedy derived from the troubled mind of Joe DeRosa. Celebrating pure evil, abandonment, and societal collapse, Joe’s bleak outlook on society will actually bring you joy in this dire climate.

title: John Mulaney: Baby J
overview: A chaotic intervention. An action-packed stay in rehab. After a weird couple of years, John Mulaney comes out swinging in his return to the stage.

title: Katt Williams: Great America
overview: The king of underground comedy takes the stage in Jacksonville with unflinching riffs on American politics and the raunchy perils of getting old.

title: Katt Williams: World War III
overview: Katt Williams riffs on truth, lies, chicken wing shortages and the war on drugs in this electrifying stand-up special filmed in Las Vegas.

title: Mens Rea
overview: In his 10th comedy special, Pandji Pragiwaksono riffs on Indonesian legal culture and the absurdities of daily life in this stand-up political satire.

title: Michael McIntyre: Showman
overview: Charming comic Michael McIntyre talks family, technology, sharks, accents and the time he confused himself for a world leader in this stand-up special.

title: Nate Bargatze: The Greatest Average American
overview: Nate Bargatze touches on Zoom comedy shows, losing his phone, hotel breakfast fails, animal caddies, new math and much more in this special.

title: Nate Bargatze: The Tennessee Kid
overview: Comic Nate Bargatze touches on air travel, cheap weddings, college football, chocolate milk and the perils of ordering coffee in this stand-up special.

title: Ricardo Quevedo: Hay gente así
overview: Droll comic Ricardo Quevedo hits Bogotá with a set that touches on embarrassing misunderstandings, sex talk, the thrill of being scared and more.

title: Ricardo Quevedo: los amargados somos más
overview: From how social media can ruin relationships to the perils of buying a gift for a woman, comic Ricardo Quevedo dissects life's trials and tribulations.

title: Ron White: If You Quit Listening, I'll Shut Up
overview: Ron "Tater Salad" White dishes out his signature brand of cynicism, riffing on sex, celebrity and the sinister habits of wild geese.

title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

title: Sebastian Maniscalco: Stay Hungry
overview: Sebastian Maniscalco brings an acerbically unique approach to peacocks on planes, life hacks, rich in-laws and life's annoyances in this comedy special.

title: Sheng Wang: Purple
overview: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

title: Stavros Halkias: Fat Rascal
overview: A snapshot of a man whose many vices are actively getting the best of him and a collection of observations, interesting experiences, and sexual embarrassments from two years of non-stop touring

title: Tom Segura: Sledgehammer
overview: From his dad's unusual deathbed confession to watching his mom get high, Tom Segura tells blisteringly candid stories about marriage, mortality and more.

title: Trevor Noah: Where Was I
overview: Trevor Noah riffs on national anthems, derailing a German sightseeing tour and getting roasted in Paris in this comedy special about his world travels.
